policy.objective: Compare discovery result quality only, not provider cost, latency or cooperation-path verbosity.
policy.candidatePool: All 207 unique companies / 253 system occurrences routed in v1.7, including old hard-gate and below-Top-10 rows.
policy.roleRule: Each company is placed in one main-role lane. Hybrid/Unresolved uses the already-selected path role only as a tie-breaker, without new path analysis.
policy.valueRule: Use the final evidence-grounded v2 total lead-value score once per canonical company; do not rescore the same company per tool.
policy.eligibilityRule: Completed leads with eligible or research-required status can occupy a search-quality leaderboard slot; ineligible leads cannot.
policy.completionRule: Each lane has ten fixed slots; missing slots contribute zero.
